jobs.description: As an orbital welding operator, you will work with various advanced welding processes and contribute to the production of high-quality stainless steel assemblies. Based on technical drawings and production planning, you will independently carry out work orders while ensuring precision and quality throughout the entire process.In this role, you will prepare and process components, perform orbital and TIG welding activities, and work with technologies such as laser welding and laser marking. You will manufacture and assemble stainless steel hoses, couplings, bends, and other complex components using orbital welding heads, welding robots, and manual manipulators.You will also be responsible for performing helium leak tests and final quality inspections to ensure all products meet the highest industry standards. In addition, you will set up and adjust machines when required and carry out first-line maintenance to support a smooth and efficient production process.Besides the hands-on technical work, you will complete work orders digitally within the system and contribute to the development and improvement of new products and production methods. As a Grinding Operator, you will be responsible for the precision grinding and finishing of high-value metal components. Grinding is a critical step in the repair process, ensuring that parts are restored to their original manufacturer specifications.In this role, you will set up and operate CNC and/or conventional grinding machines to machine components with extremely tight tolerances, often within hundredths or even thousandths of a millimeter. You will read and interpret technical drawings and work instructions to ensure every component is processed accurately and meets strict quality standards.Throughout the production process, you will perform precise measurements using instruments such as micrometers, calipers, and height gauges, while accurately recording measurement results. You will also replace and adjust grinding wheels and tooling when necessary, identify deviations, and take appropriate action to maintain product quality. In addition, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by applying Lean and 5S principles, helping to optimize processes while maintaining a safe, clean, and efficient working environment.- Experience with grinding operations is an advantage.- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.- Experience using precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, calipers, and height gauges.- Good command of the English language, both spoken and written.- A precise, quality-focused, and safety-conscious working attitude.
